name: Brooklyn Bedding
description: Online store on Shopify selling mattresses, pillows, sheets, duvet sets, mattress protection and toppers, plus some furniture. States free FedEx Ground shipping to the contiguous United States, paid shipping to Alaska, Hawaii and Canada, and no shipping to PO boxes or APO/FPO addresses. Lists showrooms.

ships_to.notes: Shipping policy states free FedEx Ground shipping to the 48 contiguous states; Alaska and Hawaii are shipped at an extra charge. No PO boxes or APO/FPO.
Shipping policy states shipping to Canada via FedEx at an extra charge.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: A Find a Showroom link is shown; showroom pickup of online orders is not stated on the pages read.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Shopify store. Search and products feed verified by the probe. Also publishes llms.txt, a UCP file and a Shopify storefront MCP endpoint.

sources.supports: delivery scope: contiguous US, Alaska, Hawaii, Canada; no PO box or APO/FPO
